page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they belong to. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: Unde etiam pollicentur illi, quibus summa rei commissa est, se cujusque existumatioGothefr. ad d 19. D.Man. Vind.nem, si forte laesa sit, aut imminuta restituturos. Hic avertimus malum, quo admisso frustra postmodum remedium adhiberemus. Ut utrobiq; sit dispar longe ratio. Unde licet in uno atque altero casu fama & vita inter sese aequiparentur, praesertim in favorabilibus. Non tamen hinc sequitur, quod per omnia sint aequalia.

Etiam alimenta & vita inter se comparantur. l.Neoare. 4.D. A-gnosc. [?] & Alend. liber.Nec tamen hinc quispiam intulerit, poena l. Corneliae de Sicariis afficiendum patrem, aut fratrem, qui alimenta filio aut fratri denegat, quod ea poena teneatur, qui occidit.
Objiciunt.6. Quod propter metum stupri, qui metus est infamiae, liceat stuprare volentem occidere; ut idem permis-l.Ifti quidem. 8. §.2.D. Quod Met caus.

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin; they are placed beside the line where they stand. Doubtful readings: the note "A-gnosc." (line 2 of the second paragraph's note) is marked [?]; "Ifti" in the last note is uncertain and the note text is abbreviated as printed. The right-margin note "D.Man." is uncertain (the printed form is small and blurred). The catchword "sum" is printed as shown; the next word is presumably "permissum". No reference marks in the text. Show-through and scan edge at the bottom right are excluded.
